- You only bring 3 of 6, so you need a team that can cover a wide range of matchups
- All Pokémon are level 50
- Item clause means no duplicate items
- Species clause means no duplicates

Let me think about what makes a good team for this format:

1. Since you only bring 3, you need versatility - each Pokémon should be able to handle multiple threats
2. You want a mix of offensive and defensive options
3. You need to cover common weaknesses

Let me think about top-tier options from the legal list:

Offensive threats:
- Garchomp - great physical attacker, Sand Rush, Dragon/Dragon STAB
- Weavile - extremely fast, Ice/Steel STAB, Pressure
- Dragonite - great bulk, Multiscale, Dragon/Flying
- Lucario - good offensive presence, Adaptability
- Scizor - great defensive presence, Bullet Proof, Bug/Steel

- Chandelure - great special attacker, Levitate
- Volcarona - great special attacker, Flame Body
- Gengar - great special attacker, Levitate
- Starmie - great special attacker, Natural Cure
- Dragonite - Multiscale makes it very tanky

Defensive/Support:
- Toxapex - amazing special wall, Regenerator
- Skarmory - great physical wall, Sturdy
- Clefable - great special wall, Magic Guard
- Slowbro - great special wall, Regenerator
- Corviknight - great physical wall, Pressure
- Chansey isn't on the list... wait, let me check. No, Chansey isn't listed.

- Garchomp (offensive, sand setter)

But wait, I need to think about what I can bring 3 of. If I bring Garchomp + Toxapex + Skarmory, I have a very defensive team. If I bring Weavile + Chandelure + Dragonite, I have a very offensive team.

- Instead of Chandelure, maybe Hydreigon? Hydreigon has Flash Fire and is a great special attacker.
